Thank you for your interest in Sacramento State!


This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in the major: Sacramento State courses on the left and approved (articulated) transfer courses on the right. notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. Students must select one course (from any major) that focuses on race and ethnic relations in the United States. The course may be either a comparative survey course, or a course that focuses specifically on African Americans, Asian Americans, Chicano/Latino Americans, or Native Americans. Courses in Western Civilization are not acceptable for meeting the World Civilization requirements for Social Science Majors. A combined Introduction to Macro/Micro Economics course is acceptable for Social Science Majors. Overlap between the Social Science Major and General Education is unrestricted, except for History courses. Only 6 units of History can be used for G.E. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Social Justice Studies is compatible with the B.A. in Social Sciences at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. For more information, please visit the Social Science Program page.
notes.contentHtml:
1. Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major.
  2. Students must select one course (from any major) that focuses on race and ethnic relations in the United States. The course may be either a comparative survey course, or a course that focuses specifically on African Americans, Asian Americans, Chicano/Latino Americans, or Native Americans.
  3. Courses in Western Civilization are not acceptable for meeting the World Civilization requirements for Social Science Majors.
  4. A combined Introduction to Macro/Micro Economics course is acceptable for Social Science Majors.
  5. Overlap between the Social Science Major and General Education is unrestricted, except for History courses. Only 6 units of History can be used for G.E.
  6. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Social Justice Studies is compatible with the B.A. in Social Sciences at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better.
  7. For more information, please visit the Social Science Program page.
